title: NPC互动系统缺乏深度且枯燥重复
description: NPC互动系统毫无意义且无聊，与NPC互动枯燥乏味。
evidence: Systems such as NPC interactions are completely meaningless and boring.
interacting with any NPC for example
The prebaked responses get old fast, I genuinely feel like I'm just talking to the same person over and over again, no one so far really striking me as unique or memorable.

evidence_items.quote: The prebaked responses get old fast, I genuinely feel like I'm just talking to the same person over and over again, no one so far really striking me as unique or memorable.
